[[File:Class_Two_lineup.png|thumb|300px|A lineup of second-degree droids]]
A '''class two''' or '''second-degree''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmed for [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and [[Technician/Legends|technical]] sciences. Such droids tended to perform tasks such as environmental work and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair.

Second-degree droids were divided into a number of subcategories: [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], [[Engineering droid/Legends|engineering droids]], [[environmental droid]]s, [[Explorer droid/Legends|explorer droids]], and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|sophisticated repair droids]].
